title: Remote Work Policy
summary: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Core hours are 10am–3pm local time.

title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
summary: Expenses under $100 are auto-approved. Over $100 requires manager sign-off. Receipts must be submitted within 30 days.

title: Data Classification Policy
summary: Data is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted. PII is always Restricted. Restricted data must not leave the VNet.

title: Access Control Policy
summary: All system access follows least-privilege. Role assignments require manager approval and are reviewed quarterly.

title: Incident Response Policy
summary: Security incidents must be reported to the Security team within 1 hour. The CISO is notified for P1/P2 incidents.

title: Acceptable Use Policy
summary: Company equipment may only be used for business purposes. Personal use is limited to break times.

title: Code Review Policy
summary: All code changes require at least one approving review before merge. Security-sensitive paths require a Security Engineer review.

title: Onboarding Policy
summary: New hires must complete IT setup, security training, and policy acknowledgements within the first 5 business days.

title: Leave Policy
summary: Employees receive 20 days PTO per year. Sick leave is separate and unlimited. Leave requests must be submitted 2 weeks in advance.

title: AI Tool Usage Policy
summary: AI tools may only be used with company-approved accounts. No confidential data may be submitted to external AI services.
